changes: After freezing, added bounded process scheduling, report/test support (including labeled scopes and table headers), and retention of temporary final-message bytes from failed CLI invocations. Frozen cases, generation prompts, candidate/proof bytes, references, rubric, author context, judges, ordering, batch matrix and retry policy are unchanged.
source_hash_policy: Freeze-time tool hash is descriptive provenance, not a prohibition on adding reporting. Attempt status hashes identify runner bytes on disk when the status was saved; source-only report additions may occur during generation. Raw inputs and accepted outputs are separately bound and strictly revalidated.
